s: June 24, 2020 - StarDist is a deep learning based cell/nuclei detection method for microscopy images. StarDist uses round star-convex shapes as detection primitives and is thus well suited for noisy images with many crowded/touching objects that can be well approximated by round shapes such as nuclei.
